description: This Java interface defines a repository for ErrorEvent entities, providing methods for querying, filtering, and deleting error events in a SQL database, using Spring Data JPA annotations.

classes.name: ErrorEventRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for ErrorEventEntity, extending JpaRepository and custom EventRepository, with methods for querying and deleting error events.

methods.name: findLatestEvents
methods.description: Retrieves the latest error events for a specific tenant and entity, limited by a specified number.

methods.name: findEvents
methods.description: Fetches paginated error events filtered by tenant, entity, time range, and optional additional filters like serviceId, method, and error message.

methods.name: removeEvents
methods.description: Deletes error events for a specific tenant and entity within an optional time range.
